capacity_status.title: Cold Storage Capacity Status
capacity_status.info: The capacity status of cold storages used to store vaccine based on volume occupied by materials.

number_of_entity.title: Number of Entity
number_of_entity.info: Distribution of entities based on the volume of cold storage occupied by materials. Divided into three categories: 0%-15%, >15%-85%, >85%-100%.

avg_order_lead_time.title: Average Order Lead Time
avg_order_lead_time.subtitle: Data from the Last 12 Months
avg_order_lead_time.info:
Order lead time is duration required to process an order placed by customer entity until it is shipped by the vendor entity and received by the customer entity.

The average order lead time is average lead time duration from all orders.

Maximum duration is the longest time recorded to complete an order process.

avg_monthly_consumption.title: Average Monthly Consumption
avg_monthly_consumption.subtitle: Data from the Last 12 Months
avg_monthly_consumption.info: The quantities of stocks used or distributed on average over the period of 12 months.

day_of_supply.title: Day of Supply
day_of_supply.subtitle: Data for Today
day_of_supply.info: Estimation of how long the supplies will last based on the calculated rate of consumption (issue/dispense).

details.title: Details of Cold Storage
details.subtitle: Click on one of the graph color categories or table data rows below to see detailed data.

functional_status.title: Functional Status
functional_status.info: Distribution of cold storage units by their current functional status.
functional_status.temp_not_set_info: The '–' sign indicates that the active temperature has not been selected. Please select the active temperature in the Temperature Monitoring Detail menu.

remaining_capacity.title: Remaining Capacity by Temperature Threshold
remaining_capacity.subtitle: Functional Status: Well Functioning
remaining_capacity.info: Distribution of capacity status of cold storages based on the type of cold storages and categories of volume occupied by materials. Remaining volume is volume of cold storages that is not used to store vaccines.

stored_materials.title: Stored Materials
stored_materials.info: Type of materials stored in cold storages of volume occupied by the materials. The information is presented in volumes in litre (L) and percentages (%).
stored_materials.has_volume: Material that already has volume information
stored_materials.no_volume: Material that does not yet have volume information

stock_of_materials.title: Stock of Materials
stock_of_materials.info: Information of quantities of stocks stored in cold storages presented in number of doses and volumes.

facilities_by_capacity_status_dist_inter.title: Number of Facilities by Capacity Status
facilities_by_capacity_status_dist_inter.subtitle: By Distribution Interval
facilities_by_capacity_status_dist_inter.info:
The capacity of cold storages in each facility compared to standard distribution interval specified for facility levels.

Based on calculation, facilities are categorized into: below interval, ideal, and above interval.

facilities_by_capacity_status_temp.title: Number of Facilities by Capacity Status
facilities_by_capacity_status_temp.subtitle: By Distribution Interval and Storage Temperature
facilities_by_capacity_status_temp.info: Remaining capacity by temperature threshold shows the total capacity used in the cold storage, calculated based on the temperature threshold. The volume used is calculated based on the materials that has the defined temperature threshold, without breaking it down by cold storage types

annual_target_coverage.title: Annual Target Coverage
annual_target_coverage.info:
Number of targets that has been converted into volume capacity (in Liter).

Coverage is accumulation of used capacities from the beginning of the year up to now.
